about: Paid routes to team power: the packages the sources discuss, with KRW prices (KR shop, crumblehub's spending plan and value table, the KR App Store), USD prices where the US App Store lists the same package, what each feeds (power source ids from power-sources.json), crumblehub's Crystal value (% of the plain Crystal pack; not team power), and the community verdict. 'usd_tier' is inferred from matching KRW price tiers on the two App Store listings (₩6,000 = $3.99, ₩7,500 = $4.99, ₩12,000 = $7.99, ₩19,000 = $11.99, ₩20,000 = $12.99, ₩45,000 = $29.99) and is marked as such. Prices as of 2026-09-28; the shop rotates.

price_tiers.paired_by: Princess Bari Welcome Pack; Daily Dungeon Key Set Pack
Crumble Pass; Ad Removal Sugar Coating Pass

packages.name_kr: 광고 영구 제거권 (광고 제거 슈가코팅 멤버십)
packages.verdict: Universal first purchase: claims every ad reward (extra daily dungeon runs, shop ad items, ad boxes) without watching; a 5,000 KRW store coupon can bring it to 2,500 KRW on Galaxy Store (KR).

packages.usd_source: tier (inferred); a global video says about $4.3
packages.verdict: Early must-buy: two rarity tiers above what oven 10 drops, it carries stages 20–30s; outgrown by about oven 25.

Second purchase for every spender: +1 daily dungeon entry during the pass, a daily key, and special rewards (10,000 Crystals, 180 cutters, 1,000 Stellar Points, 1,000 Rune Crystals, 33 keys of each dungeon, …).

KR consensus third buy for anyone playing two months or more: lifetime +1 daily dungeon entry, daily pulls and materials; with blessing 4 it gives 6 daily dungeon entries. Global dissent: Pocket Gamer found it costly for what it gives.
The best growth per KRW for spenders while new floors are open: keys on high floors pay 4,000–6,000 per run and first-clear and milestone rewards; poor while the dungeons are capped (sweeps only).
Top Crystal value (32,000 Crystals, 900 cookie and 900 pet pulls' worth over the month); pulls turn into stars and Stellar points; some call the 7,500 tier poor and prefer the 15,000.
With the 5.5 it takes each SSR pickup to 7–8★.
Coin auto-hunt hours plus special research stones (1,504–2,507% in the gallery's table); coin chests scale with the current stage, so buy late (after 168); tiers 1–2 are the cheapest.
Lucky Dough for the oven; the cheap tiers are good value.

packages.name_kr: 우주 설탕노움 추천! 스텔라 링크 패키지 Vol.1
packages.verdict: Enough to take every open constellation to about 80%; once points are open, Stellar Points are the cheapest way to add area. It doesn't open new points: past 8-3 those need cookie stars from paid pulls (dc:76290). No posted gain is tied to a Stellar Point purchase.

packages.name_kr: 우주 설탕노움 추천! 스텔라 링크 패키지 Vol.2
packages.verdict: For 90%+; players who bought several chasing 100% regret it (95% is the practical end).

The Syrup Metal source for spenders; Syrup, not Chocosteel, is the binding resource past 10. About 1.5 packs (~₩14,700) buy the expected cost of one 14→15 step, which gave about +1.5% at 1.6G (inferred from dc:75684 and dc:53079).

The community puts it last: 5★ costs about 289,000 KRW expected and 10★ about 972,000 (dc:50913), no capture gives its power gain, and its power comes mainly through the Stellar points the stars open; a blessing-7 spender says SSRs at 8★ reach end content.
Not for light spenders; a copy comes free at blessing 3.

packages.name_kr: 이름 모를 케이크 들개 획득 / 3성 패키지
packages.verdict: Top of crumblehub's value table (3★ pack 18,100%); a useful SSR tank and debuffer.
Package-only pet: 10★ gives +16% party HP, 20★ +20%; only the first tier is called worth it.
Called the worst value in the shop unless playing for years.
Buys spending levels; low value except the first tiers (Lv.1 7,500 at 1,460%).
The paid route to Fame; buyers sit 10–20 Fame levels above non-buyers.
